WITH ex AS (
  SELECT e.*, m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.valid_from, m.valid_to
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id=19)
SELECT count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS ids,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE member_id IS NULL) AS unmatched,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19)) AS in_holdout,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT marketing_consent) AS noconsent_ids,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered) AS delivered_rows,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE delivered) AS delivered_ids,
 min(contact_ts_utc), max(contact_ts_utc),
 count(DISTINCT exposure_id) AS dist_exp,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(contact_ts_utc AS DATE) < DATE '2026-05-04' OR CAST(contact_ts_utc AS DATE) > DATE '2026-05-24') AS outside_window,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(contact_ts_utc AS DATE) < valid_from OR CAST(contact_ts_utc AS DATE) > valid_to) AS outside_validity
FROM ex

SELECT count(*) AS holdout_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS holdout_ids,

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS rl,
 count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(sale_date), max(sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-27' AND DATE '2026-06-07'
SELECT etl_loaded_at, count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, m.member_id, f.net_amount, f.sales_line_id, f.channel_code,
         (w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_web_disp
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT t.member_id) AS targeted, count(DISTINCT l.member_id) AS buyers, count(*) AS n_lines, SUM(l.net_amount) AS spend,
  SUM(l.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.store_id=900) AS web_spend, SUM(l.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.store_id<>900) AS store_spend,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.store_id=900 AND NOT l.is_web_disp) AS web_lines_nodispatch
FROM targeted t JOIN lines l ON l.member_id=t.member_id
WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'

WITH ex AS (SELECT e.*, m.member_id, m.join_date, m.marketing_consent, m.tier FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE join_date > CAST(contact_ts_utc AS DATE)) AS joined_after,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE join_date > DATE '2026-05-04') AS joined_after_start,
 count(*) - count(DISTINCT (member_id, contact_ts_utc, contact_channel)) AS dup_rows,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE join_date > DATE '2026-05-04') AS ids_joined_after_start,
 count(DISTINCT contact_channel) AS channels,
 string_agg(DISTINCT contact_channel, ',') AS chs,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_campaign_contact_load WHERE campaign_id=19) AS stg_rows
FROM ex

WITH elig AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE marketing_consent AND DATE '2026-05-04' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND join_date <= DATE '2026-05-04'),
 contacted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
 hold AS (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM elig) AS eligible,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM elig WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM hold)) AS elig_holdout,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM elig WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM hold) AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted)) AS elig_not_contacted,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM contacted WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) AS contacted_not_elig
